about: Explicit circuits for every row of the level-4 borrowed-identity catalogue, rebuilt by borrowed_identities/export_circuits.py. Cite S. Singh, C. Gidney and C. Jones, "Borrowed Identities: Malleable Distillation Factories and a Unified Numerical Search," arXiv:2606.28518 (2026).
conventions: wires 0..k-1 are the outputs and k..wires-1 the checks. A gate [support, c] is the parity phase gate of the paper's Eq. (2) at angle c*pi/2^4: it applies the phase exp(2*pi*i*c/2^4) to basis states of odd parity on the support, with c taken modulo 2^4. N counts the gates with odd c, the level-4 magic states consumed; gates with even c are lower-level rotations the paper counts as free. d is the distance measured here over the odd-c gates (d_witness: gate indices of an undetectable damaging fault of that weight); d_upstream is the CSV's value.
